name: Passkeys WebAuthn + Hardened Auth Reference (TypeScript)
note: Each task runs the real vitest suite against the real Hono app via app.request(). A software authenticator in tests/authenticator.ts signs genuine ES256 assertions and builds none-attestation registrations with node:crypto, so the real @simplewebauthn/server verifier runs unmocked. The store is the in-memory MemoryAuthStore; Redis is not used and no database is involved. Not covered: attestation formats other than none, a real browser or hardware authenticator, and starting the server under bun or in the Docker image. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost from the kit files.

eval_tasks.title: Health endpoint and full ceremony round trip
eval_tasks.instruction: The service must report health and a registered software authenticator must be able to authenticate.
assertions: /health reports ok and the relying party id
registration then authentication succeeds with real signatures
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && npx vitest run tests/security.test.ts -t "SEC-07|registration ceremony"

eval_tasks.title: Origin, RP ID and challenge binding
eval_tasks.instruction: Registration and assertion verification must reject the wrong origin, RP ID, challenge, signature or missing user verification, and replayed or expired challenges.
assertions: SEC-11: wrong origin and wrong RP ID rejected for registration and assertion
wrong challenge and forged signature rejected
SEC-05: assertion and registration replay rejected; a failed attempt burns the challenge
SEC-04: challenge expires after 120 seconds and is consumed once
SEC-08: non-increasing counter rejected and not persisted
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && npx vitest run tests/security.test.ts -t "SEC-11|SEC-05|SEC-04|SEC-08"

eval_tasks.title: Sessions, cookies, registration takeover and error hygiene
eval_tasks.instruction: Login must rotate the session id, cookies must be HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax, existing accounts must not be claimable, and errors and bodies must be bounded.
assertions: SEC-09: pre-login sid is destroyed and replaced
SEC-10: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax and Max-Age on challenge and session cookies
adding a passkey to an existing user requires that user's session
no shared default user; identity bound to the issued challenge
verifier errors are generic; malformed JSON is a generic 400; oversize body is 413
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && npx vitest run tests/security.test.ts -t "SEC-09|account takeover|error sanitization|SEC-03|SEC-06"

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete passkey suite must pass with no failures.
